Gen Z Shoppers Are Buying Fine Jewelry for Themselves

A new survey finds self-purchase is now the leading reason young consumers walk into a jewelry store, outpacing gifting for the first time.

Lenore Fedow

New York—Self-purchase has overtaken gifting as the top reason Gen Z consumers buy fine jewelry, according to a survey of independent retailers released this week.

Roughly 54 percent of respondents under 30 said they bought their most recent fine jewelry piece for themselves, up from 38 percent two years ago, as young shoppers treat diamonds and colored gemstones as everyday markers of personal milestones.

Retailers say the shift is changing how they merchandise floor cases and train staff, with independent jewelers reporting stronger conversion on self-purchase clients who research online before visiting.
